EGY.note: The AI systems are in customs, which this study excludes.

facts.fact: Customs head Ahmed Amoy said Egypt has begun running three smart systems on the Nafeza platform, including automated tariff classification using AI algorithms, automated valuation against past records, and a risk system that scores each shipment before arrival.
facts.system: Nafeza automated classification, valuation and risk systems

EGY.note: No model, dataset or AI computing stated.
